rationale: The vulnerability allows untrusted tool data (review content) to be injected into privileged model instructions. The fix marks privileged_context=False when untrusted data enters the prompt, preventing the model from treating external review content as trusted instructions. This preserves legitimate review lookup functionality while blocking indirect prompt injection attacks.
